title: Best-loved band: Luis Russell
summary: He remembers no bad band but enjoyed Luis Russell most for fun and music.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Tell me, since you've been sitting in the house and thinking about a lot of the things that you've done in your life, what are some of the things that you back on and you say, "Wow! That was very exciting."
I know. What things that you look back on are very exciting, like do you recall times working with Louis Russell or with Fletcher Henderson, what?
Yeah, they're all good. I don't remember nothing bad about no band I played with, no band. Every band I played with, I enjoyed myself.
Is there any one band that you enjoyed playing with any more than the others?
I don't know. Everybody was full of fun and everybody played. They loved to play.
